verdict.rationale: Exa ships an official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (exa-labs/exa-js) with documented methods for search, answers with citations, OpenAI-style streaming via streamSearch, a webSearch tool helper for OpenAI/Anthropic agent loops, and structured-output schema support. Exa skills also teach coding agents how to build with Exa's APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python), first-party docs pages covering the SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
